about: Public-notice channels per operator or agency: pages, sites, feeds, lists and accounts through which the public is told of sewage discharges, by law, permit or voluntarily. Read by pipeline/ingest/notification_pages.py (schema and validator there; test tests/test_notice_channels.py).

channels.agency: Alliance for the Chesapeake Bay DC volunteer monitoring
channels.name: Alliance for the Chesapeake Bay DC volunteer monitoring
channels.note: Alliance for the Chesapeake Bay DC volunteer monitoring. Voluntary. Feeds CMC. (research/dc/report.md §2.6)

channels.name: DC HSEMA
channels.note: AlertDC. Voluntary; use for sewage not confirmed. (research/dc/report.md §4)

channels.name: Anacostia Riverkeeper
channels.note: Anacostia Riverkeeper on Swim Guide ('CSO in the past 48 hours' special status). Voluntary. Weekly May-September; no API. (research/dc/report.md §2.6)
channels.barrier_review: an app only (Swim Guide): no web page of its own, but no login wall either

channels.name: Anacostia Riverkeeper monitoring pages
channels.note: Anacostia Riverkeeper monitoring pages. Voluntary. Data also in CMC. (research/dc/report.md §2.6)

channels.name: Chesapeake Monitoring Cooperative data explorer
channels.note: Chesapeake Monitoring Cooperative data explorer (API). Voluntary. 29 DC stations in 2026; keyless JSON. (research/dc/report.md §2.6)

channels.name: DC Health
channels.note: DC Health river advisories (Potomac sewer line collapse update). Voluntary: DC Health's public-health authority, no notification rule cited; the only DC advisory of 2025-2026. Swimming is prohibited regardless (21 DCMR 1108.1). (research/dc/report.md §2.4)

channels.name: District of Columbia Water and Sewer Authority (DC Water)
channels.legal_basis: NPDES permit DC0021199 (EPA Region 3), Part III.B.1.h.i: a light on the Anacostia and on the Potomac, colour A during a CSO and colour B for 24 hours after
channels.note: DC Water CSO warning lights (red during a CSO, yellow for 24 hours after) and the page that describes them. One Potomac light and four Anacostia lights; the light state itself is not published anywhere (the page only explains it). (research/dc/report.md §2.1-2.2)

channels.name: District of Columbia Water and Sewer Authority (DC Water)
channels.legal_basis: NPDES permit DC0021199 (EPA Region 3), Part III.B.1.h.ii(d): record of CSO events by outfall for the prior quarter; Section E: due the 28th of January, April, July and October
channels.note: DC Water quarterly CSO reports (per-outfall record, modeled and metered). Quarter totals only; some PDFs need OCR. (research/dc/report.md §2.1-2.2)

channels.name: District of Columbia Water and Sewer Authority (DC Water)
channels.legal_basis: NPDES permit DC0021199 (EPA Region 3), Part III.B.1.h.vii
channels.note: No web form: Warning signs at all CSO outfalls. No online record. (research/dc/report.md §2.1)

channels.name: District of Columbia Water and Sewer Authority (DC Water)
channels.legal_basis: NPDES permit DC0021199 (EPA Region 3), Part III.B.1.h.ii: website on CSO nature, locations, health threats, light system and harmful conditions
channels.note: DC Water combined sewer system website. Says effects can last up to three days after rain over one inch. (research/dc/report.md §2.1-2.2)

channels.name: District of Columbia Water and Sewer Authority (DC Water)
channels.note: DC Water alert sign-up (Everbridge: emergency alerts, news releases). Voluntary; CSO alerts not mentioned. Sign-up status: not attempted (docs/subscriptions.md). (research/dc/report.md §2.2)

channels.name: District of Columbia Water and Sewer Authority (DC Water)
channels.note: DC Water news releases and public notices (large SSOs). Voluntary: no statute or permit clause requires a press release; small SSOs and routine CSOs get none. No RSS. (research/dc/report.md §2.2)

channels.name: District of Columbia Water and Sewer Authority (DC Water)
channels.legal_basis: NPDES permit DC0021199 (EPA Region 3), Part III.B.1.h.iii
channels.note: No web form: Semi-annual informational pamphlet in sewer bills. No web form. (research/dc/report.md §2.1)

channels.name: District of Columbia Water and Sewer Authority (DC Water)
channels.note: DC Water Potomac Interceptor collapse hub and water quality page. Voluntary incident hub (59 releases in eight weeks). (research/dc/report.md §2.4)

channels.name: District of Columbia Water and Sewer Authority (DC Water)
channels.note: DC Water social accounts (X @dcwater, Facebook, Instagram). Voluntary; not read. (research/dc/report.md §2.2)

channels.name: District of Columbia Water and Sewer Authority (DC Water)
channels.note: DC Water Sanitary Sewer dashboard CSV. Voluntary; 36 rows, gap September 2024 to October 2025; 'not for any commercial, legal or other use'. (research/dc/report.md §2.2)

channels.name: DC DOEE
channels.note: DOEE Anacostia and Potomac river monitoring page. Voluntary; real-time display offline. (research/dc/report.md §2.5)

channels.name: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (ECHO)
channels.note: EPA ECHO sewer overflow and bypass event records (NPDES eReporting). Voluntary publication by EPA: operators must report noncompliance to the permitting authority within 24 hours (40 CFR 122.41(l)(6)); EPA publishes the electronic reports. . Covers every operator in the state. (research/federal/report.md)

channels.name: National Park Service
channels.note: National Park Service alerts (C&O Canal conditions). Voluntary; check later. (research/dc/report.md §4)

channels.name: District of Columbia government
channels.note: potomacinterceptor.dc.gov and the five-agency E. coli feature service. Voluntary incident site; static since September 2026. (research/dc/report.md §2.4)

channels.name: News media (District of Columbia)
channels.note: No URL known (not searched): Press (HillRAG, Washington Post and local outlets). Voluntary and ad hoc. (research/dc/report.md §6)

channels.name: Potomac Riverkeeper Network community science
channels.note: Potomac Riverkeeper Network community science. Voluntary. Wednesday sampling, results Friday. (research/dc/report.md §2.6)

channels.agency: Potomac Riverkeeper Network Interceptor spill page
channels.name: Potomac Riverkeeper Network Interceptor spill page
channels.note: Potomac Riverkeeper Network Interceptor spill page. Voluntary. Incident data. (research/dc/report.md §2.6)

channels.name: Reservoir Center water quality dashboard
channels.note: Reservoir Center water quality dashboard. Voluntary. Sondes measure no bacteria; CMC samples shown; undocumented API (ask first). (research/dc/report.md §2.6)
